collector_notes: Outside-truth pack for P13 (Elcid Investments). WebSearch budget for this session was already exhausted (200/200) before the first query, so every source below was reached by a directly-constructed URL: screener.in standalone + consolidated pages, the BSE public JSON APIs (api.bseindia.com, which answer with a browser UA + bseindia Referer even though the HTML scrip page 403s), the actual BSE-filed Q1 FY2026-27 results PDF (downloaded and text-extracted locally), the company's own website, and two retail aggregators (Groww, INDmoney). NSE's public API is Akamai-blocked from this environment (HTTP 403 'Access Denied'), so every NSE-basis number below is second-hand via aggregators and is flagged as such. No legacy partial file existed at this path or at packs/ELCIDIN.json. Numbers I computed rather than read are marked derived:true with the arithmetic shown; nothing is fabricated, and fields no source printed are recorded in world_gaps.

consolidated_vs_standalone.note: Elcid files BOTH and they differ materially on every headline metric. Consolidated includes two subsidiaries named in the auditor's consolidated report (page 8): a '...Trading Company Pvt Ltd' (the first token OCRs illegibly) and 'Murahar Investments and Trading Company Limited'. Side-by-side on 18 Sep 2026, same price of Rs 1,05,130: Book value Rs 3,01,137 standalone vs Rs 4,33,672 consolidated (+44%); P/B 0.35 vs 0.24; P/E 26.7 vs 22.0; ROE 1.23% vs 1.21%; ROCE 1.45% vs 1.43%; FY2026 sales Rs 94 Cr vs Rs 134 Cr; FY2026 net profit Rs 76 Cr vs Rs 109 Cr; FY2026 EPS Rs 3,811.50 vs Rs 5,426.00; Q1 FY27 net profit Rs 34 Cr vs Rs 58 Cr; Q1 FY27 EPS Rs 1,689 vs Rs 2,878.50. screener.in defaults ELCIDIN to the CONSOLIDATED page (its own search API returns url '/company/ELCIDIN/consolidated/'), Groww/INDmoney serve consolidated-basis book value and P/E, and the BATTERY manifest's reference block (pe 26.7, book_value_inr 301137, pb 0.35) is STANDALONE. The differ must therefore establish which basis the app claims before scoring any of these as wrong.

traps.indian_digit_grouping_five_figure_price: The price string is '1,05,130' (lakh grouping: 1,05,130 not 105,130). A naive parseFloat/Number on the rendered string yields 1; a Western-grouping parser that strips commas correctly still needs the right axis scaling for a 1.44 lakh -> 87k range. Every price, book value (3,01,137 / 4,33,672) and EPS (5,426 / 1,689) field on this scrip is four to six digits, where most Indian equities are two to four.
traps.lakh_vs_crore_in_the_primary_filing: The exchange-filed statement is headed '(amount Rs. in Lakhs)' while every aggregator restates in Rs. crore. Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT is 5,756.69 lakh = 57.57 crore. A pipeline that ingests the filing and labels the unit 'crore' overstates by 100x; one that ingests screener and labels 'lakh' understates by 100x.
traps.profit_vs_other_comprehensive_income: Q1 FY2026-27 consolidated: PAT Rs 57.57 crore, but OCI on equity instruments Rs 1,936.76 crore - 34x larger. The Asian Paints mark-to-market rides OCI, never the P&L. Mixing up 'Net Profit' and 'Total Comprehensive Income' for this name produces an error of one to two orders of magnitude, in either direction depending on which field is grabbed.
traps.negative_revenue_and_negative_profit_qua: Consolidated quarterly Sales are NEGATIVE in Dec 2024 (-5 Cr), Mar 2025 (-17 Cr) and Mar 2026 (-64 Cr), because 'Net gain on fair value changes' sits inside Revenue from Operations for an NBFC. Mar 2026 consolidated net profit is -41 Cr with EPS -2,061.00. Any chart, growth rate, or OPM computed off these rows (screener itself prints OPM 99% on a -5 Cr revenue quarter and -38% on Mar 2026) is garbage. A 'revenue cannot be negative' validator will reject real exchange data.
traps.exchange_price_divergence_same_day: 18 Sep 2026: BSE close 1,07,500 (-0.46%), NSE close 1,05,130 (-1.07%). 2.25% apart, and the derived market caps differ by Rs 47 crore (2,150 vs 2,102.6). With 11 shares traded on BSE, neither is a consensus price. A quote panel that does not name its exchange is wrong half the time here.
traps.fiftytwo_week_three_way_disagreement: Three live 52-week highs on the same day: 1,44,500 (BSE/screener, dated 17/10/2025), 1,37,000 (INDmoney), 1,33,699.95 (Groww). Two lows: 87,003 (BSE, 02/04/2026) and 1,02,210 (Groww + INDmoney). Drawdown-from-high computed on the BSE pair is -27.2%; on the Groww pair it is -21.4%. Most likely cause: the NSE series began ~20 Apr 2026 so the NSE window is ~5 months, not 52 weeks - but the app must not silently pick one.
traps.standalone_vs_consolidated_44pct_book_va: Book value 3,01,137 (standalone) vs 4,33,672 (consolidated) - the same labelled metric, same day, same site, 44% apart, driving P/B 0.35 vs 0.24 and P/E 26.7 vs 22.0. screener DEFAULTS this scrip to consolidated; the battery manifest's reference block is standalone.
traps.pe_four_way_spread: P/E on 18 Sep 2026: 22.0 (screener consolidated), 22.03 (INDmoney), 22.63 (Groww), 26.7 (screener standalone), 28.31 (BSE ComHeader, which simultaneously prints EPS as blank '-'). No single 'the P/E' exists for this name.
traps.indmoney_eps_ttm_is_actually_fy26_annual: INDmoney labels 5,426.02 as 'EPS (TTM)'; that is the FY2026 consolidated ANNUAL EPS (screener: 5,426.00). True TTM is 4,773.50 (screener) / 4,773.19 (Groww). INDmoney's own printed P/E of 22.03 is inconsistent with its own EPS (1,05,130/5,426.02 = 19.38). A stale-annual-labelled-TTM field is exactly the kind of thing an aggregator-fed app inherits silently.
traps.indmoney_debt_to_asset_is_junk: INDmoney prints 'Debt-to-Asset Ratio: 0.50' for a company whose balance sheet shows zero borrowings in every year from Mar 2015 to Mar 2026. Do not trust INDmoney leverage fields for this name.
traps.name_spacing_breaks_exact_match: Exchange masters say 'EL CID Investments Ltd' (BSE) / 'EL CID Investments Limited' (NSE); the company, screener, Groww and INDmoney all say 'Elcid Investments Ltd/Limited'. An exact-string join between a master file and any data source fails. Case-insensitive + whitespace-stripped matching is the minimum.
traps.sector_is_resolvable_but_look_through_mi: Contrary to a naive reading, the classification IS unambiguous at every official source: BSE Sector 'Financial Services' / Industry 'Investment Company'; screener 'Financial Services > Finance > Investment Company'; the filing itself says 'no separate reporting segments ... Non Banking Financial Company'. The trap is the opposite direction: an agent that reasons from the ASSET (an Asian Paints stake) will classify Elcid as paints/consumer and then compare it to Berger/Kansai. Tijori already mislabels it 'Small cap Asset Management'. Peer sets, sector P/E (Groww shows 'Industry P/E 18.62') and any sector-relative screen are all wrong if look-through wins.
traps.two_hundred_thousand_shares_total: Total shares outstanding = 2,00,000 (two lakh), stated in the filing. Any formatter that renders share counts in millions shows '0.2M' or rounds to 0; any 'shares in crore' field shows 0.00002. Free float is ~50,000 shares. 11 shares changed hands on 18 Sep 2026; the 2-week average is 9 shares/day.
traps.bse_circuit_filter_is_unusable: BSE StockTrading returns CktLimit '11.00/86,000.00' while the same payload's LTP is 1,07,500. The upper bound is 20% BELOW the traded price, so this field cannot be read as today's price band (it is likely a stale percentage/price hybrid surviving from the pre-October-2024 call-auction era when the scrip quoted near Rs 3). Recorded verbatim; do not parse it.
traps.stale_three_rupee_archives: Before the October 2024 special call auction the scrip quoted around Rs 3. Archived pages, cached screenshots and any historical series that was not re-based still carry that price, so an any-source price lookup can return a value ~35,000x too low. The 52-week window no longer contains it, but multi-year charts and 'all-time' stats do.
traps.bse_attachment_path_attachhis_not_attach: The announcement API gives ATTACHMENTNAME only. https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/<guid>.pdf returns HTTP 404 with an 8 KB HTML body (content-type text/html) for the 13 Aug 2026 results; https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/<guid>.pdf returns HTTP 200, 2.43 MB, application/pdf. A fetcher that only tries AttachLive gets a 404 HTML page it may happily parse as an empty document.
traps.bse_html_403_but_json_api_200: https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/elcid-investments-ltd/elcidin/503681/ returns HTTP 403 to a plain fetcher, while api.bseindia.com/BseIndiaAPI/api/* returns clean JSON given a browser User-Agent plus 'Referer: https://www.bseindia.com/'. Also note the canonical SEO path BSE itself returns is /stock-share-price/el-cid-investments-ltd/elcidin/503681/ (with the space), not the -elcid- form.
traps.nse_public_api_akamai_blocked: https://www.nseindia.com/api/quote-equity?symbol=ELCIDIN returns an Akamai 'Access Denied' HTML page (HTTP 403) even after a cookie-bootstrap GET of the get-quotes page with a browser UA. Any NSE-primary code path will fail closed from an ordinary client; every NSE-basis number in this pack came via aggregators.
traps.screener_shareholding_row_sums_to_100_01: screener's Jun 2026 row: 75.00 + 0.00 + 0.06 + 24.95 = 100.01%. Groww/INDmoney print Public 24.94 and sum to exactly 100. A sum==100 assertion fires on screener's numbers.
traps.dividend_ttm_window_boundary: Two identical Rs 25.00 final dividends with ex-dates 23 Jul 2025 and 24 Jul 2026. A trailing-12-month dividend window anchored loosely (e.g. 'last 13 months', or calendar-year-to-date plus prior year) double-counts to Rs 50 and doubles the yield to 0.048%.
traps.zero_percent_payout_that_paid_a_dividend: screener rounds FY2026 dividend payout to 0% (true value 0.46%: Rs 0.5 Cr paid on Rs 109 Cr consolidated PAT). An app that says 'pays no dividend' from the payout row contradicts the Rs 25/share it paid ex-24 Jul 2026.
traps.roce_cliff_is_an_accounting_event: Consolidated ROCE falls 20% -> 2% between FY2018 and FY2019 solely because Ind AS fair-valuing lifted reserves from Rs 258 Cr to Rs 5,133 Cr. Narrating this as deteriorating business performance is a confident, sourced, wrong answer - the exact failure mode a finance agent must not have.

world_gaps.promoter_pledge_unreached: Pledged percentage of promoter holding. Genuinely not printed by any source reached (screener renders no pledged row; Groww/INDmoney omit the field; BSE ShpPromoterNGroup / ShpQuarterList / getShpDropDown all 302 to error_Bse.html; Trendlyne has no resolvable ELCIDIN URL - both /equity/ELCIDIN/ and /equity/share-price/ELCIDIN/ are 404). COULD-NOT-REACH, not confirmed-zero.
world_gaps.bse_listing_date_unreached: BSE listing date. Not exposed by any BSE JSON endpoint that resolved and not printed by any aggregator reached. COULD-NOT-REACH.
world_gaps.nse_listing_date_single_source: NSE listing date 2026-04-20 rests on one aggregator (INDmoney) with an unlabelled 'Listing Date' field. Consistent with the NSE-basis 52-week window but unconfirmed.
world_gaps.asian_paints_stake_single_source: The ~2.95% Asian Paints stake comes only from Groww's narrative blurb. Neither Asian Paints' shareholding pattern nor an Elcid annual report was reached to confirm the exact percentage, the number of shares, or its carrying value.
world_gaps.nse_primary_unreachable: NSE's own quote, corporate-announcement and shareholding endpoints are Akamai-blocked from this environment. All NSE-basis figures here are second-hand. WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200) before this task began, so no search-engine route around the block was available.
world_gaps.bse_corpaction_feed_unreachable: No per-scrip BSE corporate-action endpoint resolved (CorpactData, CorpactionData, SecurityInfo all 302 to error_Bse.html; the working /api/Corpaction/w?scripcode= endpoint ignores scripcode and returns a market-wide ex-date list). corporate_actions_2026 is therefore assembled from aggregators plus the announcement feed and may be incomplete.
world_gaps.annual_report_not_read: Elcid's annual reports (screener lists BSE-hosted PDFs for 2012-2026) were not opened. The investment-book composition, related-party detail, promoter-entity breakdown and the exact Asian Paints share count live there.
world_gaps.shareholding_pattern_detail_unreached: Only the four aggregate buckets were obtained. The individual promoter entities, custodian/DR holding, and the >1% public shareholder list were not reached (BSE SHP endpoints unresolvable).
world_gaps.filing_ocr_partial: The 13 Aug 2026 results PDF is a scanned document; pypdf text extraction is clean for the letterhead, notes, auditor reports and EPS but garbled across the numeric tables. Figures transcribed from those tables carry an explicit confidence field; standalone PAT is derived from EPS rather than read.
world_gaps.subsidiary_name_partial: The consolidated auditor's report names two consolidated entities; only 'Murahar Investments and Trading Company Limited' OCRs legibly. The second subsidiary's first token is unreadable ('@udingCj*PunY!,-itd').
